title: Frontend Engineer
tagline: Prompting for UI work: components, accessibility, and design systems.
description: Get coding agents to produce UI that passes review: typed, accessible components that reuse your design system, specified before they're built and verified after.

sections.title: Foundations
sections.description: Be specific and set the rules.

sections.title: Specify UI work
sections.description: Describe the component you actually need.

sections.title: Context
sections.description: Your codebase and design system, in the prompt.

nodes.title: Your design system is context
nodes.summary: Agents default to generic UI. Give them your design tokens, your component library, and an existing component as an example, and they'll compose your system instead of inventing a new one.
points: Name the component library and say 'reuse before creating'.
Paste one well-written existing component as a style example.
Refer to design tokens (spacing, colour names), not raw hex values.
State accessibility requirements explicitly, every time.

sections.title: Verify
sections.description: Tests and review for UI code.
